facts.text: Treating human factors as a tuning objective means treating the rate of unnecessary warnings and braking as a safety goal because frequent interruptions can cause operators to lose trust and disable the system.
facts.quote: Treating human factors as a tuning objective means counting the rate of unnecessary warnings and brakes as a safety goal in its own right, because operators who are interrupted too often stop trusting the system and start disabling it.

facts.text: In a seven-day NIOSH (United States National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health) test of a radar warning system on a Caterpillar 793B haul truck, 580 alarms sounded in 618 reversals.
facts.quote: In a seven-day test by NIOSH (the United States National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health) of a radar warning system on a Caterpillar 793B haul truck, 580 alarms sounded in 618 reversals

facts.text: In the seven-day NIOSH radar warning test on a Caterpillar 793B haul truck, 18 percent of alarms were false, 42 percent were nuisance alarms about objects the driver already knew of, and only 41 percent warranted action.
facts.quote: 18 percent were false, 42 percent were nuisance alarms about objects the driver already knew of, and only 41 percent warranted action.

facts.text: Researchers in the NIOSH radar warning test on a Caterpillar 793B haul truck found the audible warning disabled after shifts.
facts.quote: Researchers found the audible warning disabled after shifts.

facts.text: NIOSH reported that another radar trial on a Caterpillar 793B haul truck had occasional false alarms, but not frequently enough for the system to be ignored.
facts.quote: Of another radar trial on the same truck type, NIOSH reported that "Occasional false alarms did occur, but not frequently enough to cause the system to be ignored"

facts.text: Underground stop-capable systems were reported to shut down vehicles anywhere from once a day to 15 times during a single cut of coal.

facts.text: The booklet recommends treating nuisance rate as a safety objective, not merely a comfort objective, and including nuisance rate among optimization goals alongside misses.
facts.quote: the nuisance rate is a safety objective, not only a comfort one, and belongs among the optimization goals with the misses.

facts.text: ISO 16001, the object-detection standard for earth-moving machinery, requires that the warning cannot be disabled by a single action.
facts.quote: ISO 16001 (the object-detection standard for earth-moving machinery) requires that the warning cannot be disabled by a single action.

facts.text: Useful human-factors tuning measures are unnecessary warnings or interventions per operating hour, per loading cycle, and per reverse maneuver.
facts.quote: the useful measures are unnecessary warnings or interventions per operating hour, per loading cycle and per reverse maneuver

facts.text: A collision mitigation system tuned only for zero misses will be switched off, whereas a system tuned only for zero nuisance will miss hazards.
facts.quote: A system tuned only for zero misses will be switched off; a system tuned only for zero nuisance will miss.

facts.text: The booklet recommends a constrained multi-objective formulation for tuning, with the human-factors rate on one axis of the Pareto front.
facts.quote: The booklet's answer is the constrained multi-objective formulation, with the human-factors rate on one axis of the Pareto front
